mapper.select:
SELECT b.id AS boardId, b.user_id AS authorId, b.nickname AS authorName, b.title AS title, b.content AS content, b.view_count AS viewCount, COALESCE(b.report_count, 0) AS reportCount, b.deleted AS deleted, CASE WHEN b.deleted = 1 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'DELETED' END AS status, b.created_at AS createdAt, b.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM board b
ORDER BY COALESCE(b.report_count, 0) DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board_comment c LEFT JOIN board b ON c.board_id = b.id

SELECT c.id AS commentId, c.board_id AS boardId, b.title AS boardTitle, c.user_id AS authorId, c.nickname AS authorName, c.content AS content, COALESCE(c.report_count, 0) AS reportCount, c.deleted AS deleted, CASE WHEN c.deleted = 1 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'DELETED' END AS status, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM board_comment c LEFT JOIN board b ON c.board_id = b.id
ORDER BY COALESCE(c.report_count, 0) DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
